verdict.rationale: Gusto's own invoice ingestion reads an uploaded invoice and prefills the paysheet for review and approval before payment (gusto-docs-8). Combined with its contractor payment tools (gusto-docs-7), this covers uploading a bill and approving it before paying, but only for contractor invoices on the payroll paysheet, not general vendor bills. Missing for 10: general vendor/bill-pay support beyond contractors, multi-step or multi-approver routing, approval rules or roles, and any detailed docs or hands-on corroboration beyond a press-release line.
